command: npx vitest run <the test files of the mutant's source file> --reporter=json --outputFile=<scratch>/mutation-<id>.json
method: Each mutant replaces one fragment (asserted to occur exactly once) in its file, runs the test files listed for that file under vitest with the JSON reporter, and restores every source in finally. A mutant is killed when the run exits non-zero and at least one test fails (failedTests lists each) or is stopped after 600 s; a run that exits non-zero with no failed test and no timeout is recorded as not run, never as killed. The unmutated baseline of each group runs first and must pass.

equivalent.reason: Run 1 (at df0a36131) ran it and it survived: the frame's second column is `minmax(max-content, 1fr)`, at least as wide as the excerpt's longest line, so a line of the excerpt never meets the edge it would wrap at, whatever `white-space` says; the rule stays as the requirement's "no wrapping". The browser test measures 11 lines at 390 px, where line 15 is wider than the viewport.

range-invalid is drawn exactly where a line is not an integer from 1 or startLine is after endLine (check-derive.ts), and code-excerpt-too-long where the range holds more than 60 lines: the guard above the reading refuses each first. The reading binds the requirement's own words; bad-citation-not-skipped removes both and is killed.
